title: 2023-2024 Retail Sales Performance Report
executive_summary: This report presents the verified findings from the analysis of retail sales data for 2023-2024. Key metrics include overall revenue, regional performance, quarterly trends, year-over-year growth, high-discount electronics sales, order revenue distribution, and customer concentration. The analysis reveals significant insights into sales performance and customer behavior.

key_findings.statement: The total revenue for 2023-2024 was $445,325.09 with 520 orders, resulting in an average order value of $856.39.
Regional revenue was highest in the East ($130,516.69), followed by North ($124,845.75), West ($99,428.16), and South ($90,534.49).
Quarterly revenue in 2024 showed an increasing trend from Q1 ($36,108.31) to Q3 ($71,674.99), with a slight decrease in Q4 ($68,948.71).
Year-over-year revenue growth from 2023 to 2024 was 10.08%, with total revenue increasing from $211,976.29 to $233,348.80.
There were 22 high-discount electronics orders with a total revenue of $50,035.33.
The distribution of order revenue showed a mean of $856.39, a median of $313.28, a standard deviation of $1,295.74, a minimum of $5.27, and a maximum of $7,844.02.
There were 222 unique customers, with the top customer generating $27,793.13 in revenue, accounting for 6.24% of the total revenue.

limitations: The analysis is based on the cleaned data, which may have inherent limitations due to the original data quality.
The report does not account for external factors that may influence sales performance, such as market conditions or seasonal trends.
The customer concentration metrics may be influenced by the presence of bulk orders or high-value transactions.
conclusion: The analysis provides valuable insights into the retail sales performance for 2023-2024. Key takeaways include strong year-over-year growth, regional revenue disparities, and the impact of high-discount electronics orders. Further analysis could explore the drivers of regional differences and the effectiveness of discount strategies.
